lines.en: I decide to spend the afternoon with Ami.
lines.zh: 我决定陪 Ami 过这个下午。

lines.en: The two of us hang out in her bedroom and she proceeds to rant about the drop rates in some video game she's playing for the next half hour.
lines.zh: 我俩在她卧室里待着，接着她开始为正在玩的那款游戏的掉率抱怨了半个小时。

lines.en: Knowing absolutely nothing about whatever she's saying, I simply nod my head and try to appease her.
lines.zh: 她说的东西我一个字都听不懂，只能一个劲点头，尽量安抚她。

lines.en: Eventually, she realizes that I'm not exactly interested and winds up giving me a shoulder massage instead.
lines.zh: 到最后她总算看出来我其实没什么兴趣，于是改成给我捏肩膀。

lines.en: If you don't have a [niece], I highly recommend that you somehow procure one.
lines.zh: 如果你没有[侄女]，我强烈建议你想办法弄一个。

lines.en: I can't guarantee she'll be as good as Ami...but if she's even anywhere {i}close{/i}, I can guarantee that your life will never be the same...
lines.zh: 我不能保证她像 Ami 一样好……但只要她能有{i}那么{/i}接近，我就能保证你的生活再也不会和以前一样……

lines.en: Ami winds up cutting our hang-out session short when she realizes she still has to go run some errands.
lines.zh: Ami 想起自己还有事要办，只好提前结束了我们这次聚会。

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do, I decide to head back out and walk around for a few hours...
lines.zh: 不知道该干什么，我决定再出门逛上几个小时……
